reasoning: The question asks whether China's rebar failure rate will be below 20% in the 2025 national quality check. The 2023 baseline was 22.9% failure rate. The new GB 1499.2-2024 standard took effect September 2024 with stricter requirements. Snippet 5 mentions SAMR reported manufacturing product quality pass rate remained above 93% (implying <7% failure rate overall), but this is for manufacturing broadly, not specifically rebar. No direct evidence of 2025 rebar-specific quality check results was found. Given stricter standards typically increase failure rates initially, but also strong government quality initiatives, the outcome is uncertain. The market likely expects improvement given regulatory focus.
